==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am frustrated, because I want to attain lucidity. This is ironic. Clearly I am already lucid, because I know I am dreaming.

I realize the irony of my situation. I summon swirls of golden light around myself. I become a superhero.

I test my speed by flying through a series of tunnels. Before I can reach the end of the tunnel, my alarm goes off.
